title: FMR macropore source-faithful top-input forcing integration
objective: Add explicit source-faithful surface-to-macropore forcing for the bounded serialized single-column Reference-Richards FMR route without inferring physical source components from generic top_flux.

source_authority.limiter_authority: B1.11 MACRORATE standard-domain inflow limiting and redistribution already migrated/qualified in the macropore process stack
source_authority.forcing_rule: Only explicitly supplied source components may feed macropore top input. Generic FMR top_flux is not a provenance-preserving substitute.

admitted_target_scope: explicit source-carried precipitation/rain, surface irrigation, snowmelt, ponding/runon components only where provenance is explicit
candidate-only top-input partition with returned-surface receipt
transactional discard/retry/commit semantics inherited from A8
restart/persistence semantics unchanged except for no persistence of interval forcing
excluded: dynamic crack-geometry displacement feedback within the same corrector
inventing a new physical partition fraction not traceable to B1.11 authority
invariants: rejected trials do not mutate committed macropore or matrix state
surface input is booked exactly once
returned/rejected macropore top input remains surface-owned and is not lost
matrix/macropore internal exchange remains cancelling whole-column transfer

A9.2 define typed FMR top-input forcing carrier and fail-closed validation
